description_en: Deletes a data source and its associated metadata catalog
description_zh: 删除数据源及其关联元数据目录
name: DeleteAgenticDataSource

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the data source to delete. Ensure that no workloads are using the data source before deletion
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的数据源 UUID；删除前请确认已无业务使用
parameters.name: data_source_uuid

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the deletion was successful

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the call fails. This field is empty when the call succeeds
ErrorCode.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的错误码；成功时为空

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails. This field is empty when the call succeeds
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的错误信息；成功时为空

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use this ID to trace the call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
